notes.title: Aeterna Lucis is coming in September 2025: Wishlist now and join the adventure!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789401/504f815cc04a4d4a39603eb011e1f14b2692c692.jpg[/img]
The wait is over! Aeterna Lucis is coming this year with your support!

We have some exciting news that many of you have been eagerly awaiting: the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis, titled Aeterna Lucis, will officially arrive this year! Specifically, you'll be able to dive into this new adventure starting September 2025 on all platforms.

Continuing our beloved tradition, Aeterna Lucis will feature two distinctive difficulty modes: the Lucis Mode, crafted to be extremely challenging, demanding, and rewarding, preserving the spirit of the iconic original Noctis mode, and offering an intense platform-focused experience; and the Aeterna Mode, more relaxed and accessible, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in a metroidvania experience with a calmer pace and deeper exploration. It's truly like having two games in one!

We're especially excited to announce that the first official gameplay preview is already available on our official Aeternum Game Studios YouTube channel, showcasing thrilling new mechanics, stunning visuals, and hints of what awaits you in this epic sequel.

[h2]
Wishlist it now using this direct link and help us reach even greater heights![/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710920/Aeterna_Lucis]WishList NOW[/url]

[previewyoutube=MDjIQ89JEGE;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't wait to hear your comments, suggestions, and thoughts about what you're seeing. You're an essential part of this journey, and together we'll make Aeterna Lucis the incredible game we all dream of.

The adventure continues, and we want to share it with you. Wishlist Aeterna Lucis now and join us on this exciting new journey!

notes.notes:

Great news for all Eden Genesis fans! 🎉 We're thrilled to announce that the game is now available in **French, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese**. Yes, you read that right—Eden Genesis is now even closer to you!

Our goal has always been to help you fully connect with the adventure, and what better way to do that than in your own language? We believe that every new language adds a special touch, allowing you to dive even deeper into the story, characters, and everything Eden Genesis has to offer.

We’re super excited to hear what you think about this update. Feel free to share your thoughts, feedback, and anything else on your mind. We love hearing from you! 🎮✨

notes.title: 🚀 Dive into Action: The Eden Survivors Demo is Here! 🌌
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Eden Genesis community! 🌱
[/h1]
We are super excited to share that the demo for our new game, Eden Survivors, is now available! 🎉 This game is part of the Eden Genesis universe and promises to bring you an exciting adventure with all the guarantees of Aeternum Game Studios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789401/b421c141003dbd1a4ad78b7ffc2207b71130a007.png[/img]

Welcome, hackers, you're being transferred to Eden City to defend its citizens against the alien threat! Eden Survivors is a single-player survivor-like auto-shooter where players must defeat hordes of alien invaders until the extraction time.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073350/Eden_Survivors/]Download the demo here
[/url]

[h2]What can you expect from Eden Survivors?
[/h2]
Limitless Exploration: Dive into a vibrant and dynamic world filled with breathtaking landscapes and secrets waiting to be discovered. Every corner of Eden Survivors is designed to surprise you and keep you on a constant adventure.

Strategic Survival: Face challenges that will test your survival skills. Manage your resources wisely and enhance your abilities to thrive in a hostile environment. Survival has never been so thrilling!

Total Customization: Design and customize your survivor to your liking. With a wide variety of options, you can tailor your character to reflect your gameplay style and personality, turning them into a true hero of Eden.

Now is your chance to get involved! We need your help. Your feedback is crucial for us, and we want you to play the demo and let us know what you think. Every comment you share will help us make Eden Survivors an even better game.

So download it, dive into the adventure, and let us know what you think! Together, we can create something truly special. 💚

Thank you for being part of this community! We look forward to hearing your thoughts.

notes.title: How Eden Genesis plays on Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Aeternum Game Studios has created other titles that feature a great performance and overall control on this portable console. Aeterna Noctis got the Steam Deck verification almost immediately after its release, so we aim to get the same for Eden Genesis.

The adventures of Leah Anderson and her fight against SND are [b]currently playable on Steam Deck[/b]. These are some of the features that make the game really enjoyable on the portable console: 

[list]
[*] [b]Subtitles and interface texts are legible[/b], allowing players to navigate through menus and the narrative parts just like on a monitor screen. This is also very useful to check your score index once you beat a trial.

[*] Developing a game set in a dystopian future requires three things: rain, neon lights and streets full of life. Eden Genesis features all of them, and playing it on the [b]Steam Deck doesn't affect the performance[/b] and the value of the art and the settings. You'll enjoy the aesthetics as any other player.

[*] Eden Genesis runs great smoothly on the Steam Deck, [b]the game adapts its graphics to the portable console[/b]. The artistic value and the beauty of the environments and characters do not affect the game experience.
[/list]
Eden Genesis is a platformer set in a cyberpunk world. The way the game controls and feels makes it a perfect title to experience on a portable console. The Steam Deck can run our game at its best!

While we wait for the [b]official verification by Steam[/b], you should experience Eden Genesis by yourselves. Feel free to [b]download the demo[/b] and add the game to your wishlist!

Thanks a lot for your support, see you in the virtual world of Eden Genesis :)

notes.title: Eden Genesis will feature English voice acting!
notes.notes:
Eden Genesis is a cyberpunk adventure where platforms, exploration, a deep story, and some Metroidvania elements will be mixed... a formula that improves with the [b]voice acting of professionals like Nikki García.[/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/26279de29b888d3d244aa532c219768e231fd3f7.jpg[/img]

Our game mixes a frenetic pace and an important narrative component, with [b]a deep story set in a world dominated by corporations and neon lights[/b]. In this ever-closer future, those who have neural implants suffer a terrible fate. Leah, the main character, is one of them and it will be up to us to help her to find a cure for her dying mind.

Such a promising premise, in addition to a script that includes complex themes about the limits of technology and the human condition, demands the inclusion of voiced characters. [b]Each dialogue will feature English voices[/b], an inclusion that makes Eden Genesis a much more immersive title. To do this, we have gathered a cast of international voice acting professionals directed by Stephen Hughes who also provides the voice of one of the most charismatic characters in the video game... the all-mighty Skip-it.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/c6ce3bce74cc70e0a52c1cfca0a9e4205d100240.jpg[/img]

It should also be noted that [b]all in-game texts[/b], whether interfaces, menus or dialogues, [b]will have localization in both English and Spanish[/b]. Nikki García, Stephen Hughes, Elisabeth Gray, Adela Leiro, Schuyler Hedstrom, Robbie K. Jones, Sito Shutter, Craig Stevenson and Luis Aspe von Essen will give life to a story that will arrive on Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo before the end of the year.

It's almost time to put ourselves under the control of Leah Anderson and immerse ourselves in the virtual world of Eden Genesis!

notes.title: Special Guest Musician... Welcome, Elesky!
notes.notes:
When talent and hard work come together, all we have to do is enjoy. An example of this is the fact that the pianist [b]Elesky will be in charge of performing the piano edition of the Eden Genesis OST.[/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/13771191adf94de4aedb0eef03f68f0fc73b1b11.jpg[/img]
Elesky is known worldwide not only for her virtuosity on the piano, but also for being [b]one of the most promising streamers on the international scene[/b]. Her presence through her Twitch channel dedicated to music, her collaboration with "Conexión PlayStation Show" and her appearance at events such as the Pokemon Twitch Cup make her one of the most liked artists in the industry.

Graduated from the [b]Higher Conservatory of Music in Piano Performance[/b], Elesky is not only a content creator, she has first-class musical training, and aims to make music a profession. Among the multitude of projects in which she is involved, [b]she makes piano arrangements[/b], highlighting her work in Candlelight. There is no doubt that the incorporation of Elesky into Eden Genesis [b]will enhance the overall game experience[/b].

[i]“We want our video games to be full of talent and magic. Without a doubt, the collaboration between Juan Ignacio Teruel and Elesky will allow us to musically enjoy a unique work of art”[/i] said Fernando Sánchez, co-founder of Aeternum Game Studios.

What we know so far is that [b]Elesky will make the OST created by Juan Ignacio Teruel Torres her own[/b], interpreting the songs on the piano that we will not only be able to enjoy through the Eden Genesis Piano Collection, but will also be [b]part of the game itself[/b] so that everyone can enjoy them in-game.

notes.title: "Most Wanted" Update - 6 Days Left
notes.notes:
Dear players,

There are only a few days left to finish the campaign and we want to show you more details about the incredible “Most Wanted Ghost” reward. It would be great if you don't miss the opportunity to be eternal in Eden Genesis.

[h2][b]What is the “Most Wanted Ghost” reward in Eden Genesis?[/b][/h2]

During the game, Leah will get access to the Eden Genesis central system where the data of the most wanted and dangerous Ghosts on the network is stored. High-ranking hackers whose reward would grant millions to anyone offering information about them. Thanks to this reward you will be one of these Ghosts, becoming part of the game and its story.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/97d412dc32efa7abc40699a87762664331f840ab.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]How is the “Most Wanted Ghost” card created?[/b][/h2]

Our team will ask you for an image of yourself or even a pet, as well as characteristics of the image, references or details that allow us to create together a memorable Ghost file. Since a picture says more than a thousand words, here are some examples.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/273f412062843a935d4fd8732c890ef56a71928d.jpg[/img]

They look amazing, right? Well, it is only possible to be a Ghost in Eden Genesis and become part of our game forever through the “Most Wanted Ghost” reward, whether in its Early or Standard mode. You will also get a Collector's Edition and the digital version of the game, besides the soundtrack and other stuff…

There are only a few days left... We rely on your support to reach the next stretch goal and make Eden Genesis an even better game with your contribution.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure/rewards#reward-UmV3YXJkLVVtVjNZWEprTFRrM01qVTBOams9]See Now Reward "Most Wanted Ghost"[/url]

We are preparing more news for the upcoming days, so stay tuned because the last few days will be frantic.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Eden Genesis has reached its Kickstarter goal in record time
notes.notes:
Our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure]Kickstarter campaign[/url] reached its fund goal in just over 48 hours after the release!

Great news for the whole dev team, and we’d like to thank you all for making it possible in record time. It’s been months of hard work and getting funded in a matter of hours means a lot to us. We were confident about it, and as a token of gratitude, let’s take a look at some of the most important stretch goals we prepared for our lovely community.

The campaign for this cyberpunk platformer hides tons of surprises, including both physical rewards and extra in-game content. You’re about to learn about the first two, one that includes more gameplay options, and the other focused on getting a more immersive experience … Excited enough?

[h2][b]New tier reward[/b][/h2]

It is an expansion of the Level A Ghost (+Physical) tier but adding a digital copy of Eden Genesis for Steam. The new tier is called “Level A Ghost Plus (+Physical)”, and it has been created thanks to the feedback from the community on social media.

Thanks for your constant suggestions and contributions to the project! If you want to access this new reward at an incredible price, visit [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure/rewards#reward-UmV3YXJkLVVtVjNZWEprTFRrNE9ESTROek09]this link[/url].

[h2][b]First stretch goal, a replay and practice mode[/b][/h2]

Each trial in Eden Genesis is different from the last, presenting a unique level design and enemy presence. Your ultimate goal is achieving the best score by eliminating all hostile entities, cleaning the SND and keeping your synchro levels at maximum.

Thanks to this stretch goal you can practice adding your own checkpoints to familiarize yourself with the level. The training mode will allow you to perfect your reflexes and marks when you come to a test that seems too complex or in which you do not obtain the expected results.

By being able to add and remove checkpoints at will, you will not need to repeat the entire level. Focus on that section that you are struggling with, and practice as much as you want until you are completely familiar with the enemy layout and platform design.

[h2][b]Second stretch goal, dubbing[/b][/h2]

Eden Genesis is more than a fast-paced platformer, it also features a deep story and in order to make it more immersive, we aim to get full English dubbing for in-game dialogues.

Wish to know more? As soon as the first stretch goal is done, we’ll share more details about it…

Once again, thank you so much for your support. Let’s make the replay and practice mode a reality 😊

notes.title: Eden Genesis will feature a free demo during Stem Next Fest
notes.notes:
With the imminent celebration of the Steam Next Fest, we will release a [b]free demo[/b] to show the technical and gameplay quality of Eden Genesis.

In addition to a brief tutorial so that players can familiarize themselves with the multiple ways to overcome the challenges, the demo will also include [b]several levels taken directly from the base game[/b], plus being able to explore part of the lobby that connects the different sections of the city in which Eden Genesis takes place.

It will be up to you to learn the movement and combat skills of the charismatic Leah, adapt your playstyle to the different challenges of the demo, and achieve the best score in each of the available levels.

[b]Mark February 5 on your calendars[/b], because that day the Eden Genesis demo will be available for free on Steam. Willing to explore this new cyberpunk world and help Leah stop the virus that is consuming her mind?
